result.title: Training-free motion statistics match self-supervised behavior encoders
result.comment: 10 pages, 7 tables, 1 figure. Code will be released with the conference version
result.summary: Self-supervised encoders for animal behavior are often trained on, or fed, hand-built movement features. We ask whether they beat those ingredients when compared fairly. A training-free representation, made of generic per-frame measurements summarized over fixed time windows and reduced with PCA, is compared with retrained and released encoders (BAMS, hBehaveMAE) under a preregistered protocol: frozen representations of equal size and one shared classifier. On CalMS21 it reaches 85.8 macro F1 against 82.4 for the best encoder, ties with four labelled videos, and leads when the annotator changes or new behaviors must be learned from a few videos; the reading holds for encoders retrained with three seeds. On the MABe22 mouse triplets it scores 83.7 against 80.3 for the released hBehaveMAE (gap +3.4, 95% interval +2.1 to +4.7). On a second species, the MABe22 fly groups, the same recipe scores 51.6 mean F1 over 50 tasks against 48.2 for BAMS, the best published method. On Shot7M2, the synthetic basketball benchmark built by hBehaveMAE's authors, it scores 68.8 against 64.7 for hBehaveMAE, the best method in that paper, though hBehaveMAE remains better on the shortest movements. Short time windows carry most of the result. Raw keypoints in each body's own frame, summarized over the same windows, already match or beat the encoders on both mouse datasets and on Shot7M2; on the fly groups they fall short, and the measurements add 5.3 points. On these benchmarks, current behavior encoders have yet to beat the hand-built features they learn from, and such baselines should be reported alongside them.

AI.brief_summary: 论文在预注册协议下，用等维度冻结表示加共享分类器，比较无需训练的通用逐帧运动统计（固定时间窗汇总后 PCA 降维）与自监督动物行为编码器，在多个基准上统计特征反而更优，并主张把手工特征作为必报基线。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「学到的 latent 是否真的超过简单统计汇总」的质疑与等规模冻结表示、单分类器的公平比较协议，可能为核查 LVR 中 latent 推理状态相对朴素视觉统计基线的增量信息提供评价思路。
